hero.title: Where Technology Minds Connect, Collaborate & Grow.
hero.description: A growing technology community bringing together students, developers, innovators, and tech enthusiasts to connect, learn, collaborate, and create opportunities.

about.title: More Than Just a Community.
about.intro: We believe that great ideas grow when great minds come together.
about.story: SYNTAXO is a technology and innovation-driven community designed to create opportunities for learning, networking, collaboration and real-world experiences. Our journey starts in Visakhapatnam and grows through the people who make this community.
about.who: SYNTAXO brings together students, developers, entrepreneurs, creators and innovators to connect, learn, collaborate and build the future together.
about.mission: To connect ambitious minds, encourage collaboration and create opportunities for the next generation of innovators.
about.why: Great ideas grow when great minds come together. SYNTAXO creates a place for people to share knowledge, build relationships and turn ideas into opportunities.

vision.label: Our Vision
vision.text: To build a connected ecosystem where students, developers, creators and entrepreneurs learn together, innovate together and grow together.

what.title: Building a Stronger Technology Community
what.intro: SYNTAXO creates opportunities to learn, collaborate, lead and grow.
